rv.q: THE REVLON GIRL runs 90mins straight through without interval and will make you laugh and reach for a tissue mere moments apart.

The Revlon Girl is a funny, poignant reminder that small pockets of joy can be found in the darkest of times, and that the greed of faceless corporations causes untold damage to everyday human beings.

cn.t: Critics praise this timely Aberfan memorial for bringing brazen hilarity and brittle pathos to an untouchable subject, exploring how Welsh mothers rebuilt their lives after devastating loss.
